items.label: T4
items.content:
You may optionally upload up to three files to be included with your email. These files will not actually be attached to the email, but links to them will appear at the bottom of the email message. When your recipients click on the links they will be able to view the files.
Use the "Browse..." buttons below to select a file or files on your computer. When you click the Submit button the file(s) will be uploaded to the server so they will be accessible by your recipients.
Note: The combined size of the files may not exceed 4 MB.

Please check your mail for your copy of this message after you press Submit.  If it looks OK, press Submit one more time and send out to your entire list.  
You will be able to edit the message before it out goes out to the entire list.
